description:
## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

jsonnet_test runs jrsonnet against a staged directory of its declared sources, with `-J` derived from it, not the project root. An undeclared import fails loudly instead of being read from the checkout (hazard J1, spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An import of an undeclared file fails the test
- [ ] Existing jsonnet tests still pass

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.
title: Jsonnet test imports resolve only from declared sources
